title: What people frame, vii
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Wednesday: a customer brings in a page torn from the laundromat digest. The strip. Wood mats his own strip and charges full price. She never asks.

panels.composition: The counter. A WOMAN with a quarter-letter page, torn along one edge: a Drift Wood daily. The dog-under-the-table one.
props: a torn digest page: the strip

balloons.text: It's from the laundromat thing. My husband likes the dog.

panels.composition: The page on the counter. His own signature in the margin — A. FINCH — under her thumb.
props: the page, the signature under her thumb

panels.composition: Wood cutting a mat for it. Precise. The Owner at the back, glasses up, saying nothing, which is louder.
